description: DALL-E 3 is OpenAI's latest image generation model, offering significantly improved image quality, prompt following, and safety features compared to DALL-E 2. It understands nuanced prompts and can generate highly detailed images.

outOfScope: Generating violent, adult, or hateful content

trainingData.description: Trained on a large dataset of images and text. Specific training data composition is proprietary. OpenAI has implemented measures to reduce generation of images mimicking living artists' styles.

trainingProcedure: Uses diffusion model architecture with improvements in prompt understanding. Specific methodology is proprietary.

evaluation.performanceSummary: Significantly improved prompt adherence and image quality compared to DALL-E 2. Better at generating text within images, understanding spatial relationships, and following complex prompts.

knownLimitations: Cannot generate images of real public figures
May struggle with very specific or technical requests
Text rendering in images not always perfect
May decline requests that could be misused

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: OpenAI has worked to reduce biases and ensure diverse representation in generated images.
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: Built-in content policy enforcement, refusal to generate harmful content, watermarking through C2PA metadata, restrictions on real people generation.
ethicalConsiderations.privacyConsiderations: Generated images may be stored by OpenAI. Check terms for usage rights.

access.license: Proprietary - OpenAI Terms of Use. Users retain rights to images they create.
